title: Test map
description: Which selftests a changed file can affect (product rule 8). Read by bin/test-map.py.

runner.description: The suite runner; its suite list is the line `for t in <names>; do`.

test_file.description: Where the selftest of a target lives; {name} is the target name.

test_like.description: Globs (matched against the lower-cased path) of files that look like tests: each must be a suite selftest or be listed in not_tests.

not_tests.description: Globs of files that look like tests and are not (fixtures, the runner, this map).

follow.description: Globs of code files; a file that starts with #! is code too. A selftest reaches the files its code names.

data.description: Globs of files read as data (JSON, YAML, text lists). A file that a code or data file names may not sit in a row that adds no target beyond the always gates. An empty or missing list means every file counts.

always.description: Fast gates: targets of every selection.

full.description: Globs of shared contracts: a change selects the full suite.

scan.description: true: the targets read every matching file (a folder scan). The row adds targets and does not count as a match.
